findings.title: Pinned version not resolvable on npm breaks init and wizard for a whole CLI release
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Embed is captured from workspace manifests at build time and used as exact pins with no fallback, so a partially published release would make init/wizard installs fail; this is a different mechanism from KD-1's staleness/direction issue.

findings.title: Skew 'align' offers, defaulted to yes, to downgrade a newer installed runtime to an older CLI's versions
findings.label: match
findings.note: versionSkew uses !== with no ordering, so a newer installed runtime is offered a downgrade defaulted to yes, which is KD-1's direction defect.
